statement.fixed_exponent_equivalence: Conditional on R5-SHADOW-TAIL, for every fixed A>=0, P_n(X_n)=O(n^A) iff S_Lambda(n)=O(n^A).
statement.existential_polynomial_equivalence: Conditional on R5-SHADOW-TAIL, there exists A>=0 with P_n(X_n)=O(n^A) iff there exists A>=0 with S_Lambda(n)=O(n^A).
statement.normalized_quotient: More generally, for any positive scale g_n with |T_n(X_n)|/g_n -> 0, (S_Lambda(n)-P_n(X_n))/g_n -> 0 and ||S_Lambda(n)|-|P_n(X_n)||/g_n -> 0.
statement.route_consequence: Therefore two-sided polynomial control of the moving endpoint prefix is not a strictly weaker intermediate than the full-remainder polynomial obligation under the R5 tail premise.
statement.root_scope: Using the already-recorded R3 shadow classification only as a strength guard, the moving-prefix polynomial family is root-coupled; this result itself is not an RH proof.

proof: R5 gives T_n=O(n^{-B}) for every B>0; in particular T_n=O(1).
If |P_n|<=C n^A eventually, then |S_Lambda(n)|<=|P_n|+|T_n|<=C n^A+C_T=O(n^A) because A>=0.
Taking the union over fixed A>=0 gives existential-polynomial equivalence.
For any g_n>0 with |T_n|/g_n->0, exact additivity gives |S_Lambda-P_n|/g_n->0; reverse triangle inequality gives ||S_Lambda|-|P_n||/g_n<=|T_n|/g_n->0.
